tenders.title: VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at Smelter Plant, Angul
tenders.scope_summary: Development and commissioning of an enterprise-grade AR/VR training solution for safety, operations, and maintenance activities at the Pot Line of NALCO Smelter Plant, Angul. The solution will include hardware, software, and integration services for immersive training in critical plant areas such as Pot Room activities, anode change processes, and emergency workflows.
key_points: Develop an enterprise-grade AR/VR training solution for safety, operations, and maintenance.
Solution must include hardware, software, and integration services.
Focus on Pot Room activities, anode change processes, and emergency workflows.
Bid closing date: May 30, 2026, 10:00 AM.
Minimum average annual turnover of ₹11.36 Lakhs during the last three financial years required.
Bidder should have executed/supplied at least 1 VR Training Module during the last 7 years, successfully operating for at least 2 years.

tenders.title: BIM Modeler - Hitachi Energy Technology Services Private Limited
tenders.tendering_authority: Hitachi Energy Technology Services Private Limited
tenders.scope_summary: Hitachi Energy is seeking a BIM Modeler to produce discipline-specific BIM models, develop models to required LOD/LOI, populate models with accurate geometry, attributes, parameters, and metadata, and ensure compliance with BIM standards and naming conventions. The role also involves supporting BIM Coordinators during model federation, clash detection, and issue resolution.
key_points: Produce discipline-specific BIM models to required LOD/LOI.
Populate models with accurate geometry, attributes, parameters, and metadata.
Ensure compliance with BIM standards and naming conventions.
Support BIM Coordinator during model federation, clash detection, and issue resolution.
Resolve assigned clashes and model issues within agreed timelines.
Maintain version control and update history.
Requires Master's or bachelor's degree in electrical, civil, or mechanical engineering with 1-5+ years of BIM experience.
